success_patterns: Translate requested result counts and limits into the endpoint’s cardinality parameter, separately from per-item filters such as word length.

patch.reasoning: Across the trajectories, requests specify a single random word, ten words of a given length, and up to 100 hotel chains. Mapping cardinality independently from item-level constraints helps select the right parameters and avoid omitting a requested count.

edits.target: - Distinguish parameters that can be confused, such as quantities versus repetitions or operation-specific values versus ordinary search terms.
edits.content: - Map requested result cardinality—counts, single-item requests, and maximum result limits—to the endpoint’s count, amount, or limit parameter when supported. Keep this separate from per-item constraints such as word length.
